description: Export products from one or more WooCommerce shops through WooCommerce's public Store API: name, SKU, price, regular and sale price, currency, stock, rating, categories, attributes and images. Optional search term and sale-only filter. Use it for competitor price checks, catalog research or finding discounted items on WordPress/WooCommerce stores. Runs the Apify Actor loudtzu/woocommerce-store-products on your own Apify account (pay per event: $0.0005 per run + $0.00026 per product, billed by Apify; Apify platform usage may apply). Store page: https://apify.com/loudtzu/woocommerce-store-products

includeDescription.description: Include descriptions. Add short and full descriptions as plain text (emails and phone numbers removed).

maxProductsPerStore.description: Max products per store. Stop after this many products from each shop (default 100, max 50,000).

onSaleOnly.description: On sale only. Only products the shop marks as on sale.

runOptions.description: Optional run limits (not passed to the Actor). maxTotalChargeUsd caps what this single call can cost you on Apify.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Hard cap in USD for this run's Actor charges. Defaults to the server's MAX_CHARGE_USD (1.00 unless set).

timeoutSecs.description: Run timeout in seconds (Apify's synchronous limit is 300).

search.description: Search (optional). Only products matching this text, using the shop's own search.

storeUrls.description: Store URLs. One WooCommerce shop per line, e.g. 'https://shop.example.com'. Only the site address is used. Empty lines stop the run before anything is charged. If you leave this out, the Actor reads mercantile.wordpress.org (the official WordPress swag shop). Example: ["https://mercantile.wordpress.org"]

name: woocommerce_store_products
title: WooCommerce store product export
